name: LinkedIn Ads
description: LinkedIn Marketing API program for campaign management, reporting, audiences, conversions and company insights.
auth_notes: Outbound auth method is not visible in the provided sources; apps are created in the Developer Portal.
gate_detail: Apply for Advertising API product on an app, with LinkedIn reviewing the application; Development tier first, Standard tier upgrade at LinkedIn's discretion. Some APIs need further approval.
api_scope: Ad campaigns and creatives, ad analytics, matched audiences, conversions, audience insights, media planning and company intelligence APIs.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Advertising API access requires an application that LinkedIn reviews and may reject; private APIs need extra approval.
